description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LeaveConfigurationService component in the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the leave plugin's service layer. It contains test methods verifying the behavior of configuration retrieval and setting functions related to leave management.
published: leave configuration and test related constants and class definitions.

classes.name: LeaveConfigurationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class designed to verify the behavior of the LeaveConfigurationService, particularly its configuration retrieval and update functionalities related to leave management.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
methods.description: Tests that the getLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy method returns the expected strategy value based on mocked configuration data.

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleImplementation
methods.description: Verifies that getWorkScheduleImplementation correctly retrieves the implementation value from configuration.

methods.name: testIncludePendingLeaveInBalance
methods.description: Checks the behavior of includePendingLeaveInBalance() method for different configuration return values.

methods.name: getIncludePendingLeaveInBalanceDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for includePendingLeaveInBalance method, including cases for null, '0', and '1' strings.

methods.name: testSetIsLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Verifies that setLeavePeriodDefined() correctly invokes the DAO to set the leave period definition.

methods.name: testIsLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Tests that isLeavePeriodDefined() correctly interprets configuration value as boolean true when configured as 'Yes' or similar.

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodStatus
methods.description: Checks retrieval of leave period status, expecting a specific constant when configuration value is '1'.

methods.name: testSetLeavePeriodStatus
methods.description: Ensures setLeavePeriodStatus() updates the leave period status with the correct constant value.
